title: Cell-type-directed design of synthetic enhancers.
authors: Taskiran, Ibrahim I; Spanier, Katina I; Dickmanken, Hannah; Kempynck, Niklas; Pancikova, Alexandra; Eksi, Eren Can; Hulselmans, Gert; Ismail, Joy N; Theunis, Koen; Vandepoel, Roel; Christiaens, Valerie; Mauduit, David; Aerts, Stein
one_liner_zh: 该文利用深度学习模型从随机序列设计细胞类型特异性合成增强子，并解析转录因子基序组合与排列的调控逻辑，核心聚焦TF-DNA结合与增强子互作机制，方法为AI建模，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Transcriptional enhancers act as docking stations for combinations of transcription factors and thereby regulate spatiotemporal activation of their target genes(1). It has been a long-standing goal in the field to decode the regulatory logic of an enhancer and to understand the details of how spatiotemporal gene expression is encoded in an enhancer sequence. Here we show that deep learning models(2-6), can be used to efficiently design synthetic, cell-type-specific enhancers, starting from random sequences, and that this optimization process allows detailed tracing of enhancer features at single-nucleotide resolution. We evaluate the function of fully synthetic enhancers to specifically target Kenyon cells or glial cells in the fruit fly brain using transgenic animals. We further exploit enhancer design to create 'dual-code' enhancers that target two cell types and minimal enhancers smaller than 50 base pairs that are fully functional. By examining the state space searches towards local optima, we characterize enhancer codes through the strength, combination and arrangement of transcription factor activator and transcription factor repressor motifs. Finally, we apply the same strategies to successfully design human enhancers, which adhere to enhancer rules similar to those of Drosophila enhancers. Enhancer design guided by deep learning leads to better understanding of how enhancers work and shows that their code can be exploited to manipulate cell states.
abstract_zh: 转录增强子作为转录因子组合的停靠站，从而调控其靶基因的时空激活(1)。解析增强子的调控逻辑以及理解时空基因表达如何在增强子序列中被编码，一直是该领域的长期目标。在此，我们展示了深度学习模型(2-6)可用于从随机序列出发，高效设计合成的、细胞类型特异性的增强子，并且这一优化过程能够在单核苷酸分辨率下详细追踪增强子特征。我们利用转基因动物评估了全合成增强子在果蝇大脑中特异性靶向Kenyon细胞或胶质细胞的功能。我们进一步利用增强子设计来创建靶向两种细胞类型的“双编码”增强子，以及小于50个碱基对且完全功能性的最小增强子。通过检查朝向局部最优的状态空间搜索，我们通过转录因子激活子和转录因子抑制子基序的强度、组合和排列来表征增强子编码。最后，我们应用相同策略成功设计了人类增强子，这些增强子遵循与果蝇增强子相似的增强子规则。深度学习指导的增强子设计有助于更深入地理解增强子的工作机制，并表明其编码可被利用来操纵细胞状态。
